escenas.texto: This week in Asia, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over five hundred and sixty million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Asia edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Wednesday. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Next up, number ten, from India, Kitchen CureAI , with a video posted four days ago. Over eighteen million views. It also has nine hundred and sixty-nine comments.
At number nine, from Indonesia, Aletha Abew, with a video posted three days ago. Over eighteen million views. A Short of just forty-one seconds. It also has two hundred and fifty comments.

At number eight, from Pakistan, Heemi , with “She made a huge comeback this year!”. Over nineteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just sixteen seconds.

In position number seven, from India, Snow_berrygifts, with “He Knows My Favourite Colours Colour Challenge with Him”. Over nineteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty-six seconds.

In position number six, from India, JAI HIND OFFICIAL, with “Rakh Mein Mile Pairon Ke Nishan Aakhir Kiske The?”. Over twenty-two million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and fifty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-five seconds.
In position number five, from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Over twenty-five million views. A Short of just fifty-nine seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.

Coming in at number four, WIUFQFYEQ, with a video posted three days ago. Over twenty-eight million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

Bronze medal, ARTIST JOYBOY, with “Drawing LISA using 69 from Tarantino LLOUD”. Over thirty-three million views. And get this: it's a channel with about sixty-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-one seconds.

Silver medal, from India, Samay Raina, with a video posted two days ago. Over forty-four million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, from India, Shivapriya Official , with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for diwali”. Over forty-seven million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from United Arab Emirates, Esraa Gaming , with a video posted four days ago. Over six thousand comments. A video over seventy-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eight hundred and thirty-four thousand views.
In position number nine, from India, Shivang Mini, with a video posted six days ago. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over one point three million views.

At number eight, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted five days ago. Over eight thousand comments. A video over thirty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eight point nine million views.
Coming in at number seven, from Japan, Ado, with a video posted three days ago. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over one point seven million views.

Number six, from Iraq, أترو/Atro, with a video posted five days ago. Over ten thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Coming in at number five, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “Welcome to vietnam first light gameplay”. Over eleven thousand comments. A video over one hundred and one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five million views.
Number four, لانا و رورو, with a video posted three days ago. Over thirteen thousand comments. It also has over seven hundred and seventy thousand views.

Bronze medal, from India, Free Fire India Official, with “Free fire india is here!”. Over twenty-seven thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over five point three million views.

Silver medal, from India, What Factzz, with a video posted six days ago. Over forty-five thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds.

And finally, number one most commented, from India, Samay Raina, with a video posted two days ago. Over forty-five thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Coming in at number ten, from India, Shivapriya Official , with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for diwali”. Over three hundred and fourteen thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty seconds.
In position number nine, from India, Rhino Rule, with a video posted six days ago. Over three hundred and seventeen thousand likes. It also has over nine point seven million views.

Next up, number eight, from India, Gyan studio Bari, with a video posted six days ago. Over three hundred and nineteen thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-three thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over ten million views.
Next up, number seven, from United Arab Emirates, Priya and Sid, with a video posted four days ago. Over three hundred and twenty-eight thousand likes. It also has over ten million views.

At number six, from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Over three hundred and forty-five thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-nine seconds. It also has over twenty-five million views.

Next up, number five, from India, What Factzz, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and seventy-five thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

In position number four, Indu kanchan Singh, with “karodon ki deal chhoti Bahu ki samajhdari Se hua final”. Over four hundred and seventy-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over nine point nine million views.

Bronze medal, from Pakistan, Heemi , with “She made a huge comeback this year!”. Over five hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just sixteen seconds.
Silver medal, from India, Kitchen CureAI , with a video posted six days ago. Over six hundred and eighty-four thousand likes. It also has over sixteen million views.

And finally, number one most liked, from India, Samay Raina, with a video posted two days ago. Over one point two million likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And some news: starting week forty-five we add TikTok. The ten most viral TikTok videos of the week, right here too. Don't miss it. And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Asia every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
